page_plan_source: HQ-approved 10-page plan (HQ Directive UP-002, confirmed in UP-004): 1 Front Page; 2 City Beat; 3 Crime & Neighborhood Watch; 4 Editorial & Opinion; 5 Arts, Music & Entertainment; 6 Business & Neighborhood Life; 7 Community & Classifieds; 8-9 Puzzle Dojo; 10 Back Page — Sewer Cap & Community Features.
rules: Status definitions: READY = source layout on main, content populated, artwork placed, validators pass; PARTIAL = some of that exists; MISSING = nothing usable exists.
Sources with location 'unmerged' live only on a draft PR branch and are recorded by SHA-256 so they can be recovered; they must land on main before assembly.
No content is invented here: MISSING means MISSING.
